Job Description AI Engineer Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize AI-powered applications using modern code generation tools, AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows, agentic frameworks, and robust software engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop AI-enabled applications using modern AI coding assistants and agentic frameworks.
Build, customize, and optimize AI agents for complex business workflows.
Develop and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Agentic RAG solutions.
Integrate vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval pipelines to improve AI application performance.
Leverage AI code generation tools to improve developer productivity and code quality.
Implement property-based testing and automated testing strategies to ensure application reliability.
Work with specification-driven development frameworks (such as Spec Kit or similar) to build maintainable, scalable software.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
Continuously evaluate emerging AI frameworks, libraries, and best practices.
Required Skills Experience
Hands-on experience with AI code generation tools such as Kiro, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or GitLab Duo.
Experience with Spec Kit or similar specification-driven development frameworks.
Strong understanding and practical experience with Property-Based Testing.
Experience building and deploying AI Agents and multi-agent workflows.
Strong knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and Agentic RAG.
Experience working with RAG libraries and orchestration frameworks.
Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or similar languages.
Familiarity with LLM integration, prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.
Knowledge of software engineering best practices, testing, and CI/CD pipelines.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
